name: Requirements Elicitation
description: Turn discovery conversations into clear, testable requirements and open questions.

sections.title: Desired Outcomes
sections.instruction: Describe the business need, users, and outcomes in the speakers' terms.

sections.title: Current State and Pain Points
sections.instruction: Summarize the existing process, constraints, and pain points.

sections.title: Requirements
sections.instruction: List functional, nonfunctional, data, and business-rule requirements. Preserve stated priority or acceptance detail.

sections.title: Constraints and Dependencies
sections.instruction: List constraints, assumptions, integrations, dependencies, and exceptions.

sections.title: Unresolved Questions
sections.instruction: List gaps that require clarification or confirmation.

sections.title: Actions
sections.instruction: List owners and next steps without inventing assignments.
